reason: Concrete long-side rules for US stocks using 52-week highs plus filters on daily bars with Donchian exits.

setup.rule: 52-week high with decent volume and EPS increase
setup.quote: I long 52 week highs, I short 52 week lows with a few added parameters, nothing major like, they've got to have a decent volume and an increase in earnings per share

setup.rule: smooth chart higher on right than left over 1-2 years
setup.quote: I'm looking for smooth charts. I look over a year or two years daily chart, and I really just want to see a smooth-ish line where it's higher in the right hand side than it is on the left hand side

entry.rule: buy at next day market open after scan confirmation
entry.quote: the following day, at the market open to for a UK time, I just open the trade with the trade size at the stop

stop.quote: I use Donchin channels. And I follow certain Donchin channel time frames. ... I found 20, the 20 days pretty good. I've looked at 40

exits.quote: every day when the market closes, I look if the stop needs to be raised ... I literally get stopped out on every trade

sizing.quote: I risk between 2% and 4% per trade. ... I like maybe eight positions at the max

ambiguities.issue: short side mentioned but engine is long-only
exact Donchian period and momentum min pct not numeric
ambiguities.assumption: use 20-day Donchian and 0 for min pct
